name: Hutt City Council
story: By 2000, Hutt City Council’s Land Information staff had supplied aerial photographs for the Chilton Saint James vegetation-fire GIS project. Council practitioner Greg Drummond acted as the project’s GIS in School mentor.

sources.label: New Zealand Fire Service Commission Research Report No.10, A Pilot Study to Identify Strategies to Assess Vegetation Fire Hazards, Chilton Saint James School
